The vector omits sleep_position — unreachable from a completed quiz (every position value emits a priority; reachable minimum is 2) — and exists solely to pin the length-1 rendering contract through the real engine.
meta.answerSetProvenance: Authored for the 2026-08-07 correction pass; NOT from any shipped test suite and NOT producible by the quiz UI (sleep_position omitted). Executed through the real extracted engine like every other scenario; evidence about the length-1 rendering contract only.
meta.method: Extract-and-execute from index.html at the worktree commit (see PROVENANCE.md): showProfileScreen()+renderResultsTrialFocus() against the recording DOM shim of tests/consultation_priorities_check.mjs; calculateScores()+qualifyRankedChoices()+window.showResults against data/mattresses.json + data/quiz.json. No scoring, ordering, cap or firmness value is reimplemented or edited.

gold.name: Reserve Mayfair Medium
gold.highlight: Hand-made balanced luxury with natural materials
gold.highlight_es: Lujo equilibrado hecho a mano con materiales naturales

topPickReason.en: Hand-made luxury in a true medium — the most versatile bed in the Reserve line.
topPickReason.es: Lujo hecho a mano en un medio verdadero — la cama más versátil de la línea Reserve.

detail.en: Neither plush nor firm — a safe luxury pick for couples who disagree.
detail.es: Ni suave ni firme — una elección de lujo segura para parejas que no se ponen de acuerdo.

detail.en: Hand-made with breathable natural layers built to outlast foam-only beds.
detail.es: Hecho a mano con capas naturales transpirables que duran más que las camas de pura espuma.

gold.name: The Roma
gold.highlight: Handcrafted firm luxury in Merino wool and cashmere
gold.highlight_es: Lujo firme artesanal en lana Merino y cachemira

topPickReason.en: Handcrafted natural-fiber luxury with firm, breathable coil-on-coil support.
topPickReason.es: Lujo artesanal de fibras naturales con soporte firme de doble resorte que respira.

title.es: Capas de confort de fibras naturales

detail.en: Merino wool, camel hair, and cashmere breathe and temper heat in a way synthetic foams can't.
detail.es: La lana Merino, el pelo de camello y la cachemira respiran y regulan el calor como las espumas sintéticas no pueden.

title.es: Doble resorte con látex de grafito

detail.en: Responsive lift and stability instead of the slow sink of memory foam.
detail.es: Elevación receptiva y estabilidad en lugar del hundimiento lento de la espuma viscoelástica.

gold.name: The Saint Pierre
gold.highlight: Our most indulgent plush — wool, cashmere, and 16.5 inches of luxury
gold.highlight_es: Nuestro suave más indulgente — lana, cachemira y 16.5 pulgadas de lujo

topPickReason.en: The most luxurious plush in the store — natural fibers over layered coil support.
topPickReason.es: El suave más lujoso de la tienda — fibras naturales sobre capas de resortes.

detail.en: A sink-in soft surface for side sleepers who want cloud comfort without bottoming out.
detail.es: Una superficie envolvente para quienes duermen de lado y quieren confort de nube sin hundirse hasta el fondo.

detail.en: Wool and cashmere keep the plush layers cooler than dense foam pillow-tops.
detail.es: La lana y la cachemira mantienen las capas suaves más frescas que los pillow-tops de espuma densa.

silver.name: Platinum Summit Medium
silver.highlight: Balanced medium comfort with cool gel memory foam
silver.highlight_es: Confort medio equilibrado con espuma de gel fresco

topPickReason.en: The balanced pick — medium hybrid comfort with a cooling gel layer.
topPickReason.es: La elección equilibrada — confort híbrido medio con capa de gel refrescante.

detail.en: The feel most couples agree on — balanced give and support.
detail.es: La sensación en la que la mayoría de las parejas están de acuerdo — equilibrio entre suavidad y soporte.

detail.en: Cool gel tempers the memory-foam warmth common in medium beds.
detail.es: El gel fresco compensa el calor de la espuma viscoelástica común en camas medias.

silver.name: Kendall Luxury Medium
silver.highlight: Conforming luxury medium that stays still all night
silver.highlight_es: Medio de lujo que se adapta y permanece quieto toda la noche

topPickReason.en: Balanced medium comfort with wrapped coils that keep partner movement on their side.
topPickReason.es: Confort medio equilibrado con resortes envueltos que mantienen el movimiento de tu pareja de su lado.

title.es: Aislamiento de movimiento con resortes envueltos

detail.en: Each coil moves alone, so a restless partner doesn't wake you.
detail.es: Cada resorte se mueve solo, así una pareja inquieta no te despierta.

detail.en: Foam layers contour without the deep sink of memory-foam beds.
detail.es: Las capas de espuma se contornean sin el hundimiento profundo de las camas viscoelásticas.

silver.name: Platinum Paige Firm
silver.highlight: Luxury 16-inch box top with firm zoned support
silver.highlight_es: Box top de lujo de 16 pulgadas con soporte firme zonificado

topPickReason.en: Luxury box-top comfort with firm, zoned center-third support.
topPickReason.es: Confort box-top de lujo con soporte firme zonificado en el centro.

detail.en: 25% more support under hips and lower back, where most beds sag first.
detail.es: 25% más soporte bajo caderas y espalda baja, donde la mayoría de las camas se hunden primero.

detail.en: A tailored 16-inch profile with plush surface layers over a firm core.
detail.es: Un perfil de 16 pulgadas con capas superficiales suaves sobre un núcleo firme.

bronze.name: Gracie Medium
bronze.highlight: Balanced medium comfort at the friendliest price
bronze.highlight_es: Confort medio equilibrado al precio más amigable

topPickReason.en: Easy balanced comfort with zoned support — the smart starter pick.
topPickReason.es: Confort equilibrado fácil con soporte zonificado — la elección inteligente para empezar.

detail.en: Classic coil bounce that's easy to move on — no stuck-in-foam feeling.
detail.es: Rebote clásico de resortes fácil para moverse — sin sensación de quedar atrapado en espuma.

detail.en: The most affordable way into a zoned Restonic build.
detail.es: La forma más accesible de entrar a una construcción Restonic zonificada.

bronze.name: Giselle Plush
bronze.highlight: Soft, welcoming plush at an everyday price
bronze.highlight_es: Suavidad acogedora a un precio cotidiano

topPickReason.en: Honest plush comfort for side sleepers at an everyday price.
topPickReason.es: Confort suave honesto para quienes duermen de lado a precio cotidiano.

detail.en: Softer than the Gracie — made for sleepers who want cushion first.
detail.es: Más suave que el Gracie — hecho para quienes buscan acolchado primero.

detail.en: Restonic quality without the Platinum price.
detail.es: Calidad Restonic sin el precio Platinum.

bronze.name: Giselle Firm
bronze.highlight: Straightforward firm support at an everyday price
bronze.highlight_es: Soporte firme directo a un precio cotidiano

topPickReason.en: Dependable firm alignment at an everyday price.
topPickReason.es: Alineación firme confiable a precio cotidiano.

detail.en: Solid support without plush layers softening the surface.
detail.es: Soporte sólido sin capas suaves que ablanden la superficie.

detail.en: The affordable path to a true firm mattress.
detail.es: El camino accesible a un colchón firme verdadero.

cardPriorities.note: Verbatim output of buildMattressPriorities(m) per surviving model per language ({title, desc, tag, matched} rows). The production card template renders the first three rows; prototypes do the same by index and never re-derive or reorder them.

results.note: tierData is the verbatim projection of _resultsState.tierData: per-tier order, qualification (>=60% of tier max), cap 3 and min-2 back-fill exactly as the engine produced them. pct/score are included for provenance and parity checking only — neither may be rendered on any screen.

compareDemo.note: SIMULATED saved-finalist state for the Compare discoverability demo — save history is customer input, so savedOrder is authored (tier leads in save order) and disclosed as such. The PAIR is computed by executing the real extracted compareReviewFinalists() (index.html:17398-17409) against that state, never re-typed. Prototype interactions against this state are prototype behavior, not production.
